name: shinchantw_cbt_first_charge_product_20260729_160831_261303
sql:
/* 首充商品分布：只统计用户历史第一笔有效充值，首充日期落在所选周期内。 */
WITH UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
AllUserFirstCharge AS (
    SELECT
        v."#user_id" AS user_id,
        v.product_id,
        CAST(v.pay_amount AS DOUBLE) / COALESCE(s5.exchange, 1) AS pay_amount_usd,
        v."$part_date" AS charge_date,
        v."#event_time" AS event_time,
        TRY_CAST(v.role_lev AS BIGINT) AS role_level,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v."#user_id" ORDER BY v."#event_time") AS charge_rank
    FROM ta.v_event_18 v
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange s5
      ON v."$part_date" = s5.ex_date AND v.pay_currency = s5.currency
    WHERE v."$part_event" = 'charge'
      AND (v.sandbox IS NULL OR v.sandbox = FALSE)
      AND (v.is_freebuy IS NULL OR v.is_freebuy = FALSE)
),
TargetFirstCharge AS (
    SELECT fc.*
    FROM AllUserFirstCharge fc
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist ub ON fc.user_id = ub.user_id
    WHERE fc.charge_rank = 1 AND ub.user_id IS NULL
      AND fc.charge_date BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-29'
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN 'D' = 'D' THEN CAST(DATE_TRUNC('day', CAST(t.charge_date AS DATE)) AS VARCHAR)
        WHEN 'D' = 'W' THEN CAST(DATE_TRUNC('week', CAST(t.charge_date AS DATE)) AS VARCHAR)
        WHEN 'D' = 'M' THEN CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(t.charge_date AS DATE)) AS VARCHAR)
        ELSE '已合并'
    END AS "时间维度",
    COALESCE(dp."product_id@product_name_tc", CAST(t.product_id AS VARCHAR), 'unknown_product') AS "商品名称",
    dp."product_id@product_type" AS "商品类型",
    CAST(t.product_id AS VARCHAR) AS "商品ID",
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.user_id) AS "首充人数",
    ROUND(SUM(t.pay_amount_usd), 2) AS "首充总收入(USD)",
    ROUND(SUM(t.pay_amount_usd) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.user_id), 0), 2) AS "首充客单价(USD)",
    ROUND(AVG(t.role_level), 1) AS "平均等级",
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(t.role_level, 0.5) AS "等级中位数"
FROM TargetFirstCharge t
LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_13_0_20639 dp
  ON CAST(t.product_id AS INTEGER) = CAST(dp."product_id@product_id" AS INTEGER)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 5 DESC;
